dct_description_sm: This tabular dataset contains 16,685 City of Milwaukee residential and commercial permit-work records as of September 18, 2026. Fields include date opened, address, record identifier, permit type and status, issue date, construction cost, building use, and effect on dwelling units. The records include permits issued from 2015 through June 15, 2026, with some cases opened earlier. The source portal states that the dataset is updated monthly.
Original source: City of Milwaukee Open Data Portal.
